title: Get Preview URL
description: Returns the preview URL for a chat. If the preview isn't ready, the response is null. Poll this endpoint until the response is non-null.
content:
# Get Preview URL

## Usage

<CodeVariant
language="TypeScript"
title="TypeScript Example"
code={`import  from 'v0'

const result = await v0.chats.getPreview({
chatId: 'chat_abc123',
})

console.log(result)`}
/>

<CodeVariant
language="cURL"
title="cURL Example"
code={`curl -X GET "https://api.v0.dev/v2/chats/chat_abc123/preview" \
-H "Authorization: Bearer $V0_API_KEY" \
-H "Content-Type: application/json"`}
/>

## API Signature

### Request

#### Path Parameters

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "chatId",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The unique identifier of the chat.",
"deprecated": false
}
]}
/>

### Response

<APISignature
title=""
parameters={[
{
"name": "url",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The preview URL for this chat.",
"deprecated": false
},
{
"name": "token",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "A short-lived token for accessing the preview URL via the x-v0-preview-token header.",
"deprecated": false
},
{
"name": "expiresAt",
"type": "string",
"required": true,
"description": "The ISO timestamp when token expires.",
"deprecated": false
}
]}
/>
